answer: Bait clone farms with a split cipher. Each epoch the network cuts a key into 3 shares and hands them to 3 IDs drawn at random; anyone who rebuilds it can claim a 30-token bounty before the next epoch's horizon. Honest strangers never see each other's shares, so they can't. A farm whose clones fill all 3 draws from one shared lagoon of servers can, and the claim proves one operator held every seat: those IDs merge into one and forfeit unvested rewards. Skipping the bait doesn't help, since each unclaimed round is reissued with a bigger bounty. Sizes are my assumptions.
